response.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_telescope_count FROM station_stats) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandusagepct, s.telescope_count, s.telescope_count / a.avg_telescope_count AS telescope_ratio FROM station_stats s CROSS JOIN avg_count a ORDER BY telescope_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
